name: Dujella–Peral · Z/4 · Rank 6
description: Published Dujella–Peral family over Q(r) with torsion Z/4Z and exact generic rank 6; Rank Hunter reconstructs the printed polynomial model and six published Mordell–Weil generators exactly.
generic_rank_status: Dujella–Peral prove exact generic rank 6. Rank Hunter operationally exact-certifies the published generic lower bound 6 at r=1; the paper's generic upper-bound argument remains theorem provenance.

source.name: Andrej Dujella, High rank elliptic curves with prescribed torsion

auto_search.strategy_note: Search the published generic-rank-6 Z/4 subfamily; exact torsion match and exact point independence are required before promotion.

provenance.authors: Andrej Dujella and Juan Carlos Peral
provenance.paper: An elliptic curve over Q(u) with torsion Z/4Z and rank 6
provenance.journal: Rad Hrvatske akademije znanosti i umjetnosti. Matematičke znanosti 28 (2024), 185–192
provenance.published_claim: The paper proves that the displayed elliptic curve over Q(r) has torsion Z/4Z and exact rank 6.
provenance.rank_lower_control: The paper states that the six displayed independent points may be specialized at r=1 to prove independence.
provenance.exact_rank_control: The paper states that r=13 satisfies the Gusić–Tadić injectivity conditions, giving exact rank 6 over Q(r).
provenance.reconstruction_status: The plugin transcribes the expanded a6(r), factored b6(r), P1–P4, and the published full-basis replacements R5,R6 exactly.
provenance.release_claim_boundary: Rank Hunter exact-certifies the lower bound 6 at r=1. The paper's exact generic-rank theorem is retained as provenance because core currently operationalizes verified generic lower bounds rather than a separate generic upper-bound evidence object.
